label: Monotone power: a power for p is a power for whatever holds at every accessible p-world
definition: PowerForMonotoneAt F PowerFor w: for every y and propositions p, q, if q holds at every world accessible from w where p holds, then a power of y at w for p is a power of y at w for q.
note: Stipulated bridge reading of PowerFor (DEF bf7eddca): an exercise that issues in p obtaining issues in q obtaining. Its cost is that any power is then a power for whatever holds at every accessible world. The possibility reading (possibilityPower) satisfies it. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §63.
